title: OPEN CITY 2027
headline: Open City
location: Online, with the finale at the Melbourne School of Design
summary: A summer design challenge for architecture, UI/UX and graphic design students from every university in Melbourne.
description: Over eight weeks of summer, students from different design disciplines take on one shared challenge facing Melbourne. The best work is presented at a live crit, awards night and open exhibition in Week 2 of Semester 1, 2027.
dateNote: Launch date to be locked in. The finale is around 9–11 March 2027.

details.brief: The theme and full brief are released at launch in early December 2026, along with mentor videos from the judges on the OPEN CITY Discord.

keyDates.label: Finale: live crit, awards and exhibition

eligibility: Bachelor and Masters students at any university or tertiary provider in Greater Melbourne
Categories: A. Architecture · B. UI/UX Design · C. Graphic Design
Solo or teams of up to 3, one entry per person
prizes: $3,500 cash prize pool across all three categories
People’s Choice Award ($200), voted by finale guests
Industry prizes such as studio tours and portfolio reviews (TBC)
